payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each of 3 starting patterns, compute minimum mismatches over all length-k substrings using a sliding window that updates mismatch sum by adding new char and subtracting old char.
payload.rationale: The code initializes mismatch array for first k characters, then slides window: res.append(res[-1] + (s[j]!=cur) - mis[j-k]). This is classic fixed-size sliding window with amortized O(1) updates per step.
